notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only site-specific source is the firelookout.ca Wawa page (steel, address, elevation, two map sheets, no notes). Nothing else was found; two searches gave no site-specific hit. Fact-check 2026-10-20: all 9 evidence quotes were found on the first run. The story body is about 133 words. Changes: the 1963 map sentence now says the map suggests the tower was standing by then, rather than stating it as the index's own finding. The towermen and fire-district sentences were reworded so they no longer copy the source wording. Still open: the 'Hawk Junction' address is attributed to the index and kept as stated. The firelookout coordinates (48.02267, -84.73608) look to be only a few km from Wawa town by my own estimate (not sourced). Earlier notes report that Wikipedia places Hawk Junction about 30 km east of Wawa (not re-checked here), so the address may be a geocoder label; check on a map before publishing the location. Name collision to check: a fan-site still-standing list (stillstanding2.html, item 55) names a 'Wawa Lake Tower- Wawa, Ont.'. Nothing links it to this tower, so it is not used. A Facebook group caption mentions a 'Helen Mine fire observation tower in Wawa' erected 1950; it is a mine tower and is not used. The firelookout 'Year Built' field holds the text 'Steel tower.' rather than a year, so no construction year is known. No photos found; access and visit facts are omitted because no source describes them.
